title: AstraMoE-SR: Trajectory-Guided Diffusion for Blind Satellite Jitter Deblurring and Super-Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2609.07012v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pushbroom satellite imaging couples limited spatial resolution with platform attitude instability. Platform jitter produces spatially varying motion blur because each scan line is acquired under a different instantaneous attitude, while perspective geometry causes the same perturbation to induce different pixel displacements across the field of view. Existing blind restoration methods that assume a spatially invariant kernel and satellite jitter correction methods that rely on auxiliary observations are therefore not directly applicable. We present AstraMoE-SR, a single-image framework that jointly restores motion blur and spatial resolution without auxiliary measurements. translated_title: AstraMoE-SR：面向盲卫星抖动去模糊与超分辨率的轨迹引导扩散模型
translated_abstract: 推扫式卫星成像同时受限于有限的空间分辨率和平台姿态的不稳定性。平台抖动会产生空间变化的运动模糊，因为每条扫描线都是在不同的瞬时姿态下采集的；同时，透视几何导致相同的扰动会在整个视场内引起不同的像素位移。因此，假设空间不变模糊核的现有盲复原方法，以及依赖辅助观测的卫星抖动校正方法，都无法直接适用。我们提出AstraMoE-SR，一个无需辅助测量即可联合恢复运动模糊和空间分辨率的单图像框架。我们不估计模糊核，而是通过在推扫式几何下将退化过程重新参数化为局部曝光轨迹来推断相机的运动方式。条件扩散模型估计轨迹的分布，缓解了高频细节的过度平滑问题。
tldr: 提出AstraMoE-SR框架，将卫星抖动退化重新参数化为推扫几何下的局部曝光轨迹，并利用条件扩散模型估计轨迹分布，实现单图像、无需辅助测量的运动模糊去除与超分辨率联合复原。
en_tdlr: AstraMoE-SR reparameterizes satellite jitter degradation as local exposure trajectories under pushbroom geometry and employs a conditional diffusion model to estimate the trajectory distribution, enabling joint blind deblurring and super-resolution from a single image without auxiliary measurements.
